title: Accounting for vertical variations in urban heat and air pollution exposure
desc: Urban heat and air pollution exposure are commonly assessed at ground level; however, their intensity can vary with height. Thus, in fast-growing dense high-rise cities, vertically resolved air quality, heat, and epidemiological evidence is needed to support floor-based health risk assessments.

title: Kremlin Backs UN Security Council Reform, But Says Permanent Members and Veto Powers Should Remain
desc: Russia supports reforms to the UN Security Council that would increase the number of permanent members but otherwise rejects proposals to abolish veto powers, the Kremlin said Tuesday. “We believe that the Security Council certainly needs to be reformed,” Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters during a daily briefing.
